thread:
incident-bot: Pager fired — high 5xx + 429 rate for org=VegaGroup in us-east-1. threshold=5m-error-rate>12%. alerted at 1812507777

alex: picking up — oncall eng-sre. what's the customer impact?

sara: VegaGroup support ticket: ~60% of their requests are getting 503/429, public UI degraded, multiple customers in their org complaining. They say it started ~10m ago.

maria: looking at runtime dashboards — overall cluster cpu/gpu fine, but request-level queuing is high on the inference tier. per-org token usage for VegaGroup spiked 6x (batching+long prompts).

alex: ok. can we confirm whether this is our global throttling kicking in or their client?

maria: both. we have global prefix cache pressure + per-org token quota; VegaGroup exceeded their burst allowance, got 429s. But because they retried aggressively, we're seeing cascading 503s in the model pool.

sara: customer asks for immediate fix — they can't serve paying users.

alex: temporary plan: 1) apply emergency per-org quota override for VegaGroup to allow current inflight requests to drain; 2) add a soft qos cap to their traffic to smooth retries; 3) disable non-critical heavy ops (reranker) at routing for that org. will coordinate with runtime.

maria: can do. prepping CLI override. will also drop their dynamic reranker route so requests use cheaper path.

alex: execute the override and share commands here. include rollback instructions.

maria: running now —
```bash
# bump VegaGroup token quota by 4x for 20m
redwoodctl org update --org vegagroup --override "tokens_per_min=80000" --expiry 20m
# disable reranker for org
redwoodctl routing set --org vegagroup --disable-route reranker --reason "emergency surge"
```

maria: command applied, api returned: {"status":"ok","override_id":"ov-9f3b"} — deploy-bot will post the rollout trace.

deploy-bot: Applied org override ov-9f3b to vegagroup (tokens_per_min=80000) by maria @ 1812508002

alex: monitoring metrics now — watch 5xx/latency on the org and model pool queues. sara, can you message the customer we applied an emergency quota bump and disabled reranker? set the expectation: we will keep this for 20m and then reassess.

sara: on it. DM to VegaGroup sent. they replied: "thanks — we see progress but some requests still failing."

maria: seeing 429s drop ~80% for that org, 5xx falling but tail latency still ~2.4s (was 3.8s). model queues reduced. good sign.

alex: next — add token-bucket smoothing to limit harmful retry bursts while honoring the override. i'll push a policy to shape to 500 rps with priority for interactive tokens.

maria: prepping policy change — applying policy:
```json
{
  "org": "vegagroup",
  "policy": "qos-shape",
  "share": 0.7,
  "max_rps": 500,
  "priority_classes": ["interactive","system"]
}
```

maria: policy active. results: request rate smoothed, tail latency trending down.

support: customer reports their web page errors reduced to ~5% now. they asked if this will be permanent.

alex: no, temporary. plan: keep override for 20m, monitor. after that we will revert and open a follow-up with VegaGroup to discuss rate limits and recommended client backoff. create a postmortem ticket.

jason: i'll take the 2nd-half handoff at 1812509000. alex — make sure you capture rollback steps and links to dashboards in the handoff.

alex: copying rollback steps:
```
# rollback override
redwoodctl org revoke --override-id ov-9f3b
# re-enable reranker (if safe)
redwoodctl routing set --org vegagroup --enable-route reranker
```

maria: metrics stable for 6m after policy. keeping override until 1812509577. will notify before revoking.

alex: thanks team. escalation notes: cause=unexpected customer burst + insufficient client backoff; mitigation=per-org quota bump + qos shaping + disable heavy route; impact=reduced 5xx/429 for VegaGroup, minor increased cost while override active; follow-ups=postmortem + recommended client-side rate limiter sample code.

sara: filing support ticket follow-up and flagging account for outreach.

jason: acknowledged, taking over at 1812509000. will monitor until revoke and then cut new ticket for long-term quota change if needed.

incident-bot: Incident thread status: mitigation applied, monitoring. owners: alex, maria. severity: Sev3.

alex: handoff complete. I'll add the dashboard links to the ticket and add steps for the PM + AE to contact VegaGroup about better backoff. :white_check_mark:
